bio: A restaurant with a unique location inside the Los Leones football stadium, which makes it the perfect way to end a visit to the Tour San Mamés and its beautiful museum as you can enjoy your meal overlooking the pitch. The cuisine, overseen by renowned chef Fernando Canales, focuses on traditional Basque recipes, with some dishes to share and three tempting set menus (Especial, Gastronomía Vasca, and Degustación). On match days, the restaurant also serves guests in the VIP section of the stadium....
